subject: Olive Retail: proof-of-performance request and accelerated term discussion
messages:
From: Claudia Moreno <claudia@oliveretail.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Lee <sam@oliveretail.com>
Date: 2027-11-10T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Short window: performance validation + contract term question

Rafael,

Quick context: our procurement team is evaluating options for our NLP inference layer ahead of a large holiday rollout. We have an incumbent plus one other vendor running a side-by-side. Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a short, focused proof-of-performance that demonstrates sustained 99th percentile latency at our 4k token templates and post-quantization throughput at peak QPS. They also want a revised term sheet if we commit to a 12-month capacity uplift.

Can you confirm whether a lightweight benchmark trial is possible within 7 business days and what concessions (if any) Redwood can offer on term length / uplift pricing? We need the materials to present at our vendor review on 11/24.

Thanks,
Claudia
VP Product, Olive Retail

--
Attachment: olive_requirements_v1.pdf (reference)

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Claudia Moreno <claudia@oliveretail.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam@oliveretail.com>
Date: 2027-11-11T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Short window: performance validation + contract term question

Claudia — thanks for the clarity and timeline. Short answer: yes, we can stand up a narrow proof-of-performance focused on your 4k templates and the exact QPS profile you shared.

Proposal outline (high level):
- 5 business day focused benchmark (isolated workload with your templates)
- Dedicated reserved slots for the trial window (to avoid noisy neighbors)
- Deliverables: 99th/95th latency profiles, per-token cost delta, and a short runbook to reproduce results
- Commercial: if you sign a 12-month uplift commitment within 7 days post-trial, we can provide an accelerated term offer: 10% off unit price and a one-time implementation credit to cover migration costs

I attached a compact snapshot of our current Q4 perf numbers and a draft term offer. If that sounds good I’ll schedule an intake call tomorrow and loop in engineering for the trial plan.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: olive_q4_perf_snapshot.csv; term_offer_OLIVE_v3.pdf

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-15T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Olive Retail trial scope and SRE support

Rafael / Ben — I pulled the workload footprint they shared. Quick notes:
- 4k token templates will push kv-cache pressure; recommend enabling prefix caching and 8-bit quant path for trial runs
- We should reserve 2x the baseline QPS for burst safety and capture 10-minute rolling windows for 99th pct
- Ops ask: access to a sanitized sample of their templates (no PII) + a signed test window SLA (we can redact)

Operational asks for trial pack:
1) KV cache runbook (I can provide)
2) Dedicated instance pinning for the 5-day window
3) Quick automation to upload their templates and seed tokens

If we can commit to those, marketing can convert the report into a short exec one-pager for procurement. Recommend we offer the 10% uplift concession Rafa proposed but gate the implementation credit on a signed uplift within 7 days after the trial report.

-Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood

--
Attachment referenced: kvcache_runbook.md

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: Claudia Moreno <claudia@oliveretail.com>, Sam Lee <sam@oliveretail.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-18T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Short window: performance validation + contract term question

Claudia — we spun up a focused trial plan with Ops and can meet your 7 business day window. Operational checklist below and asks from your side:
- Redwood will run a 5-business-day benchmark starting 11/19 (we can shift +/- 1 day)
- Deliverables: CSV performance snapshots, 95/99 latency plots, cost-per-embed and per-token delta, and a 1-page executive summary for procurement
- Offer if signed within 7 days after final report: 10% unit price discount on a 12-month uplift + $15k implementation credit

We need from Olive: sanitized template bundle (S3 link or zipped attachment), confirmation of target peak QPS, and a counter-signed trial SLA. Sam — can you drop the template bundle by EOD? If you prefer, we can accept an S3 presigned link.

If that timeline works I’ll send the DocuSign for the trial SLA and a draft term sheet.

Cheers,
Rafael

--
Attachments included: olive_q4_perf_snapshot.csv

From: Claudia Moreno <claudia@oliveretail.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Lee <sam@oliveretail.com>
Date: 2027-11-24T10:39:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Short window: performance validation + contract term question

Rafael — appreciate the quick turnaround and clear checklist. Sam uploaded a sanitized template bundle to the shared S3 link this morning and procurement confirmed they’ll review the DocuSign SLA as soon as it arrives. Two quick asks from procurement:
1) Can you include a single-slide comparison that maps your 99th percentile number to the incumbent’s public benchmark? They want an apples-to-apples visual in the vendor review.
2) If we sign the uplift commitment within 7 days, procurement asked whether the implementation credit can be applied to a migration services line item rather than a generic credit.

If you can confirm those two items, procurement will factor Redwood as a preferred finalist for the 11/24 vendor review.

-Claudia
VP Product, Olive Retail

On Wed, Nov 17, 2027 at 09:21 Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Claudia — sending the SLA and draft term sheet now.
>
> On the one-slide comparison: we can produce that, and we’ll normalize to template length and tokenization assumptions.
>
> Regarding the credit, we can earmark the implementation credit to a migration services line item; I’ll reflect that in the DocuSign.
>
> I’ll follow up with the final report and the DocuSign link once the trial completes.
>
> Best,
> Rafael
